answer: Canyon peer-audit bond: each agent locks 70 credits on a canyon post. Each epoch a beacon draws one auditor per target; the target files a signed dune-crest reading for the epoch seed. The auditor checks it on the public horizon table; a mismatch or reused serial burns the bond; a rented false pass fines the auditor 35. Each fake pays 95/epoch (30+40+25); 1000 fakes cost 95,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file one true reading, keep bonds.
